design_gotchas.title: CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 7.0 V (Rec 5.5 V) — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 24 V VIN
design_gotchas.detail: Even though VIN handles 28 V (30 V abs max), EN (Pin 5) is rated ONLY to 5.5 V recommended / 7.0 V abs max! Connecting EN directly to a 12 V or 24 V bus (as allowed on TPS562201 or AP63300) permanently destroys TPS54202. Leave EN floating to auto-enable or use an R4/R5 UVLO divider.

design_gotchas.title: 500 kHz Switching & 2 A Limit vs Pin-Identical 400 kHz / 3 A Sibling TPS54302DDCR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS54202DDCR shares the exact SOT-23-6 pinout, 28 V VIN, 7 V EN cap, and 0.596 V VREF with TPS54302DDCR, making them close siblings below 2 A. However, TPS54202 runs at 500 kHz (vs 400 kHz), has higher 148/78 mOhm FET RDS(on) (vs 85/40 mOhm) and 2.5 A min HS limit, and Table 7-2 specifies 10-15 uH inductors plus a 56-75 pF C6 feedforward cap for low-ESR ceramics.

design_gotchas.title: VREF = 0.596 V Differs From Pin-Compatible TPS562201/TPS563201 (0.768 V) and AP62200 (0.800 V)
design_gotchas.detail: TPS54202DDCR matches the 6-pin SOT-23/TSOT-23 pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BOOT) of TPS562201DDCR, TPS563201DDCR, and AP62200WU-7, but its 0.596 V VREF is 22-26% lower. Dropping it onto an existing divider without recalculating R2/R3 under-regulates VOUT by ~25% (or causes +29-34% overvoltage in reverse).

design_gotchas.title: Completely Incompatible Pinout vs AP63300WU-7 and AP63203WU-7 Despite Identical 6-Pin Body
design_gotchas.detail: Do NOT confuse TPS54202DDCR (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=FB, 5=EN, 6=BOOT) with Diodes AP63300WU-7 or AP63203WU-7 (1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST). Mounting one on the other's pads shorts SW, GND, EN, and FB immediately.

typical_use_cases: Industrial 12 V and 24 V distributed bus step-down to 5.0 V or 3.3 V at up to 2 A continuous load
EMI-sensitive white goods, home audio, printers, and set-top boxes using 500 kHz +/-6% spread spectrum
Compact 6-pin synchronous buck upgrade replacing higher-loss non-synchronous SOIC-8 or TO-263 regulators
engineering_summary: The TPS54202DDCR is a 4.5 V to 28 V input, 2 A continuous synchronous buck converter in SOT-23-6 (DDC) integrating 148/78 mOhm MOSFETs, internal loop compensation, 5 ms soft-start, Eco-mode pulse skip (45 uA Iq), and EMI-friendly 500 kHz +/-6% spread-spectrum switching (~95% peak efficiency at 12 V to 5 V). It is the pin-compatible 2 A, 500 kHz sibling of 3 A / 400 kHz TPS54302DDCR (and pin-incompatible with AP63300WU-7/AP63203WU-7). Engineers MUST respect its 7.0 V abs max EN pin limit (float to enable), recalculate dividers for VREF = 0.596 V, and pair with 10-15 uH inductors and 44 uF ceramic Cout; always verify against the official TI datasheet before production.
